title_ja: 新通貨選択生存保障重視型個人年金保険（指数連動型）『みのり １０年』を改定
title_en: Revision of the new currency-selectable, survival-benefit-focused individual annuity insurance (index-linked) 'Minori 10-Year'
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life announced on 2 August 2024 a revision to its index-linked individual annuity "Minori 10-year", effective 5 August 2024. The revision adds 3-year deferment periods for USD and AUD contracts and 3- and 5-year periods for yen contracts. It also changes the investment approach of the reference index, replacing real estate with currency and credit assets. The maximum single premium rises from 1 billion yen to 2 billion yen. Some sales agents may not offer every deferment period.

title_en: Launch of currency-selectable whole life insurance (coverage-suppression period type) 'Ookina, Magokoro 3'
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance (MS&AD Group) announced on 31 March 2025 that it will sell the revised single-premium whole life product "Ookina, Magokoro 3" from 1 April 2025, replacing "Magokoro 2". The revision adds a Three Major Diseases/Nursing Care/Dementia course alongside the existing Basic and Withdrawal courses. It also adds a social contribution rider and partial surrender for most courses, and raises the maximum basic sum insured from 1 billion to 2 billion yen. Which courses are offered depends on the sales agency.

title_ja: 新通貨選択利率更改型終身保険『しあわせ、ずっと４』を発売
title_en: Launch of new currency-selectable interest-renewal whole life insurance 'Shiawase, Zutto 4'
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance announced on 31 March 2025 that it will put 'Shiawase, Zutto 4' on sale on 1 April 2025. This revises the foreign-currency-selectable, interest-rate-renewing whole life product 'Shiawase, Zutto 3'. The revision adds the yen as a contract currency alongside USD, AUD and EUR. It also adds a partial surrender rider and raises the maximum single premium from 1 billion yen to 2 billion yen.

title_ja: 委託先保険代理店における情報流出の可能性について（第二報）
title_en: Possible information leak at outsourced insurance agency (second report)
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life gave a second report on 2 May 2025 about a ransomware attack, confirmed 16 February 2025, on their sales agency Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group. Files on some of its data servers were encrypted, and they contained policyholder personal data: names, contact details, birth dates and policy summaries. About 60,000 Aioi Life customers and 11 Primary Life customers may be affected, and those figures may change. No leak or publication of the data has been confirmed. The agency will notify affected customers in turn.

summary_en: On 29 August 2025, Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life issued a third report on the possible data leak at their agency partner Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group. The group's investigation is complete. An external specialist found no evidence that customer information left the company, and none that the attacker published it. Customers who might have been affected had already been contacted by the agency. The release also gives contact lines for the agency and both insurers.

title_en: Revision of the currency-selectable special whole life insurance 'Yasashisa, Tsunagu 2'
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life announced on 30 September 2025 that it will revise its currency-selectable special whole life insurance "Yasashisa, Tsunagu 2" (a lump-sum product for lifetime gifting) from 1 October 2025. The revision widens the combinations of survival-benefit payment counts and whole-life coverage multiples, including shorter gifting periods for yen contracts. It lowers the surrender deduction rates on US dollar and Australian dollar contracts. It also raises the maximum lump-sum premium from the amount giving a basic sum insured of ¥1 billion to the amount giving ¥2 billion.

title_ja: 新通貨選択生存保障重視型個人年金保険（指数連動型）『みのり充実』 全国の代理店で販売開始
title_en: New currency-selectable survival-benefit-focused individual annuity (index-linked) 'Minori Juujitsu' goes on sale at agencies nationwide
summary_en: Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life announced on 31 March 2026 that it will start selling "Minori Juujitsu" on 1 April 2026 through 30 agencies. This is an index-linked, currency-selectable individual annuity that emphasizes survival benefits. It replaces the earlier similar product "Minori 10-nen". Customers choose between a 100% death-benefit course and a 70% death-benefit course. Contract currency is USD or JPY, the deferral period is 3, 5 or 10 years, and the annuity fund reflects the maximum rise of a reference index.
